Call this when a human wants a daily affirmation, a morning practice, or manifestation content to start their day.

tools.name: mq_about

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "manifestingquantum-mcp.ibrobertb23.workers.dev" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mq_start_challenge, mq_search_content · Private data: mq_about · Public sink: mq_about.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mq_start_challenge, mq_search_content · Private data: mq_about · Public sink: mq_about

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
